verdict.rationale: Hatchet is open-source and self-hostable, meaning users running their own Control Plane inherently own their Postgres-backed data in a standard, open format (hatchet-docs-8/17, hatchet-gh-1/2), which supports a 'no lock-in' narrative. However, there is no explicit documentation of a data-export feature, export format guarantees, or migration tooling for users on Hatchet Cloud who want to leave with their data. Missing for 10: explicit export/backup tooling or docs, cloud-to-self-host migration guide, and any confirmation of data portability beyond raw Postgres access.
